relations.subject: Kashi Prasad Jayaswal
relations.evidence: K. P. Jayaswal was born in Mirzapur, North-Western Provinces (now in Uttar Pradesh), and graduated from Allahabad University.

relations.subject: Kashi Prasad Jayaswal
relations.evidence: He went on to Jesus College, Oxford University, where he was awarded the Davis Scholarship in Chinese and graduated with a M.A. in Ancient Indian History in 1909.

relations.subject: Kashi Prasad Jayaswal
relations.evidence: He was called to the Bar of Lincoln's Inn in London in 1910.

relations.subject: Kashi Prasad Jayaswal
relations.evidence: came into contact with Sir Ashutosh Mukherjee, who inspired Jayaswal to undertake further research in ancient Indian history.

relations.subject: Kashi Prasad Jayaswal
relations.evidence: He was twice elected president of the Numismatic Society of India

relations.subject: Kashi Prasad Jayaswal
relations.evidence: Jayaswal was the grandfather of Oxford economist Sanjaya Lall.

relations.subject: Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar'
relations.evidence: Jayaswal loved Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar' like a son and assisted him during the early days of his poetic career.
